positioning: SovereignDocs commercial core catalog: document automation, official-source prep, partner routing, compliance tracking, and e-sign/vault operations. SovereignDocs is not a law firm and does not provide legal advice.

competitive_lanes.name: Business Formation OS
competitive_lanes.summary: LLC, corporation, nonprofit, DBA, foreign qualification, dissolution, and amendment prep workflows with official-source routing and partner review escalation.
competitive_lanes.boundary: Prep and routing only unless a separately contracted partner service is configured. No filing guarantee.

competitive_lanes.name: Compliance Command Center
competitive_lanes.summary: Annual report tracker, license register, renewal calendar, good-standing checklist, statutory/registered agent referral path, and status dashboard.
competitive_lanes.boundary: Tracks and prepares; official deadlines and submissions must be verified with the current agency or partner.

competitive_lanes.name: IP & Trademark Launch Lane
competitive_lanes.summary: Trademark search worksheet, USPTO Trademark Center prep packet, copyright intake, IP assignment/NDA bundle, and partner review routing.
competitive_lanes.boundary: USPTO and government filings remain official-source/external unless a live partner filing integration is proven.

competitive_lanes.name: Estate & Life Planning Lane
competitive_lanes.summary: Will, trust, healthcare directive, power of attorney, asset inventory, beneficiary worksheet, and partner review submission path.
competitive_lanes.boundary: High-risk life-planning documents stay gated and should route to partner review.

competitive_lanes.name: Partner Legal Access
competitive_lanes.summary: Document review requests, consultation intents, partner network routing, service-plan catalog, triage queue, and no-guarantee receipt flow.
competitive_lanes.boundary: Partners are external. Any attorney-client relationship, if created, is between the user and partner under partner terms.

competitive_lanes.name: E-sign, Vault & Order Tracking
competitive_lanes.summary: Draft packages, DOCX export, signed package intake, order tracking, customer dashboard, audit ledger, and upstream-auth ready account surfaces.
competitive_lanes.boundary: Native e-sign is audit-record capture until an external e-sign provider is connected.
